falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom featured a sharp V-recovery; breaking above pre-correction levels this quickly would indicate a different regime (blowoff/melt-up) rather than the extended basing/consolidation typical of that pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 39 suggests elevated complacency risk; sustained VIX sub-14 would indicate fear has fully evaporated and the 'bottom' call was wrong—this would confirm a false breakdown and resumed risk-on euphoria, not a durable bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 5+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained flight-to-quality bid in bonds with yields collapsing would signal recession panic rather than the 'soft landing correction' the bottom_2024_aug pattern implies; this would mean the macro engine misidentified the regime (recession vs. correction), invalidating the bottom call

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
